capabilities: Sync vault files bidirectionally with a OneDrive folder
Preview planned uploads, downloads and deletions without changing files
Resolve conflicts with Keep Both, Newer Wins, Local Wins or Remote Wins
Upload files over 4 MiB through chunked upload sessions
Sign in with OAuth 2.0 device code flow
extras: Ships with a preconfigured Microsoft first-party client ID so no Azure app registration is needed; custom client IDs are kept across updates. OAuth tokens are stored in the plugin's data.json and excluded from sync, as are workspace files and the local .nomedia file.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in step with a OneDrive folder, and mobile devices cannot use Node modules or redirect-based OAuth sign-in.

relations.evidence: Synchronize your Obsidian vault with any folder in Microsoft OneDrive (Personal or Work/School)

summary: Two-way sync between an Obsidian vault and a chosen OneDrive folder, using QuickXorHash comparison and OAuth device-code sign-in on desktop and mobile.
